title: Asymptotic Normality of the Hill Estimator in Linear Preferential Attachment
summary: We prove asymptotic normality of the Hill estimator based on the largest $k_n$ degrees in a homogeneous linear preferential attachment graph with $n$ vertices. Each new vertex sends a fixed number $m\ge1$ of edges sequentially to older vertices, with attachment weight $d+δ$ and fixed $δ>-m$. Let $α=m/(2m+δ)$. For every deterministic sequence $k_n\to\infty$ satisfying $\sqrt{k_n}(k_n/n)^α\to0$, the estimator, centered at $α$ and multiplied by $\sqrt{k_n}$, converges to a centered normal law with an explicit variance strictly smaller than $α^2$.
